retained_mechanisms.name: compact-generated-state-frontiers
retained_mechanisms.mechanism: queue GeneratedStateId handles and retain canonical position slices in the transition table

retained_mechanisms.name: predicate-first-dictionary-visitation
retained_mechanisms.scope: all production DictionaryNode backends with representation-specific overrides
retained_mechanisms.mechanism: compute transition acceptance from the edge label before cloning or constructing the child handle

retained_mechanisms.name: lock-free-bounded-snapshot-storage
retained_mechanisms.scope: producer arena, consumer immutable-node cache, and query fault delivery
retained_mechanisms.mechanism: append-only atomic slots with fallible growth, dense-prefix/sparse-overflow lookup, query-local fault mailboxes, and owner/key separation

retained_mechanisms.name: class-only-characteristic-label-cache
retained_mechanisms.scope: CachedUnitTransitions for byte, char, and u64 labels
retained_mechanisms.mechanism: direct and overflow label entries retain only a compact class ID; one central class table owns each characteristic pattern

rejected_mechanisms.name: flat-contiguous-generated-transition-matrix
rejected_mechanisms.interpretation: row expansion and copying outweighed any indexing or locality benefit

rejected_mechanisms.name: compact-foreign-edge-child-identifiers
rejected_mechanisms.interpretation: re-resolving accepted children in the hybrid directory cost more than the removed per-edge atomic pointer

rejected_mechanisms.name: foreign-node-structure-of-arrays
rejected_mechanisms.interpretation: parallel-array indexing and lost edge-record locality outweighed the denser label scan
